newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish bond yields, crown flat, summit in focus.
newsitem.headline: Swedish bond yields, crown flat, summit in focus.

text.p: 0750 GMT - Swedish bond yields and the crown opened little changed on Monday with market players focusing on the European Union (EU) summit in Amsterdam.

"There has been some sabre-rattling which has been interpreted to mean that a stability pact deal will be delayed, so the mark is firming to the dollar," a trader said. "But players will take a wait-and-see view until they see results."
* Six-month T-bill falls one basis point to 4.16 pct
* Ten-year bond yield flat at 6.77 pct
* Crown flat at 4.4770 to mark vs 4.4770 late on Friday
